methods.description: Identify the result being recorded, list each different possible label once in braces, and check omissions/repeats; distinguish a physical label list from the sample space.

Read a supplied sample space to check its order, membership and number of different outcomes, and recognise that it does not give repeated-card or marble frequencies or establish equal chances by itself.
